p: city of David: Which was Bethlehem.
high places: Where altars were appointed before the temple was built, to offer to the Lord.
father: For his father had commanded him to obey the Lord and walk in his ways, 1Ki 2:3.
Gibeon to sacrifice there: For there the tabernacle was 2Ch 1:3.
kept for him this great kindness: You have performed your promise.
go out or come in: That is, to behave himself in executing this charge of ruling.
great a people: Which are so many in number.
enemies: That is, that their enemy would die.
a dream: He knew that God had appeared to him in a dream.
stood before him: By this example it appears that God kept his promise to Solomon in granting him wisdom.
took my son from beside me: She stole the living child to avoid both the shame and punishment.
Bring me a sword: Unless God gives judges understanding, the impudency of the trespasser will overthrow the just cause of the innocent.
in no wise slay it: Her motherly affection appears in that she would rather endure the rigor of the law than see her child cruelly slain.
